editorial:
Ever wonder if the bad guys in fairytales are actually just misunderstood? You get to find out in this colorful ride where Lilith, one of those mean stepsisters, accidentally ruins everything with a magic wand. Instead of a fancy party, she ends up turning her sister Margot into a frog and letting a total nightmare take over the palace. It is a wild, funny setup that flips the old Cinderella story on its head. You will love seeing Lilith try to fix her mistakes while hanging out with a very cute troll and a much nicer version of Cinderella than you remember. The whole vibe is bright, silly, and feels like a big hug for anyone who has ever felt like the odd one out.

What really works here is how fast the story moves and the great chemistry between the characters. The animation is stunning, and the jokes land perfectly without being too cheesy. While a few parts of the plot feel a bit rushed, the heart of the story makes up for it. You should definitely watch this with your family on a lazy weekend.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Lilith realizes that being a hero is about kindness, not magic. She uses the wand to turn Margot back into a human and stops the mean girl from stealing the crown. The big twist is that the troll was actually a cursed prince from a neighboring land. Everyone learns to forgive each other, and Lilith finally finds her own happiness without needing a prince, proving that anyone can change their story.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fairytale twists and funny animated adventures.
